title: EnchantRework
description: This plugin reworks the mechanics of Bane of Arthropods and Smite enchantments, making them strategically important
body:
# EnchantmentRework ## Description This plugin reworks the mechanics of **Bane of Arthropods** and **Smite** enchantments, making them strategically important. **Without enchantment**: damage to vulnerable mobs is reduced by 30% **With enchantment**: damage to vulnerable mobs is increased by 30% This encourages using specialized weapons for different mob types. ## Affected Mobs
Bane of Arthropods - Spiders - Cave Spiders - Bees - Silverfish - Endermites
Smite - Zombies - Zombie Villagers - Husks - Drowned - Skeletons - Strays - Wither Skeletons - Phantoms - Wither - Zoglins - Zombified Piglins - Skeleton Horses and Zombie Horses - Bogged
## Commands `/enchantrework reload` — reload configuration ## Requirements - Minecraft 1.21+ - Spigot/Paper/Folia or forks - Java 21+
